_comment: Authoritative measured results. Every number quoted in any markdown file
must appear here with a matching value, or CI fails. See check_docs.py.
Store numbers at FULL measured precision. Documents may display them
rounded; the checker rounds the declared value to the precision shown.
'source' must resolve to a file in this repository, or carry an
Do not edit a value here to make a document pass. Re-run the computation,
update this file from its output, then update the documents.

cmu_baseline_scaled_manhattan_eer.source: external: Killourhy & Maxion, DSN 2009, Table 2 (Manhattan scaled)
cmu_baseline_scaled_manhattan_eer.description: Published baseline on the same 51 subjects. Reported as 0.096 (SD 0.069). Previously stored as 0.0962, a digit that appears in no computation in this repository and could not be traced to the paper; transcribed from a summary. We do not beat this yet.

cmu_if_vs_ocsvm_t_statistic.description: Paired t-test, Isolation Forest vs One-Class SVM across 51 subjects.

cmu_if_vs_ocsvm_p_value.description: Paired t-test p-value. NOT the 4.7e-21 from the Advanced notebook, which t-tested a vector against itself scaled by 1.1.

legacy_export_negative_dwell_fraction.description: Share of human samples with negative mean dwell under the caret-index pairing defect.

legacy_export_median_dwell_ms.description: Median mean_dwell_time before the fix. Physically impossible; measures the bug.

participants_collected.description: Distinct consenting participants in the collection study.

cmu_subjects.source: external: Killourhy & Maxion, DSN 2009, Section 3 (subject pool)
cmu_subjects.description: Subjects in the CMU DSL-StrongPasswordData benchmark. Every per-user EER in this table is computed across all of them.

cmu_gap_to_baseline_percent.description: How far our best EER sits above the published baseline: 0.1367 / 0.096 - 1. Stated as ~40% before, which understated it.

detector_automation_tpr.description: Automation detector true-positive rate on the labelled fixture (constant-rate machine bursts with two think pauses each, 50 seeds). Fixture-derived, not field-derived.

detector_automation_fpr.description: Automation detector false-positive rate on HUMAN streams only (50 seeds). Takeovers are excluded: their trailing machine segment is genuinely automation.

detector_drift_tpr.description: Drift detector true-positive rate on takeover streams (human then sharp machine), 50 seeds. Fixture-derived.

detector_drift_fpr.description: Drift detector false-positive rate on single-typist human streams, 50 seeds.
